test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Shovana Narayan, a Padma Shri awardee, is a dancer of which of the following classical dance forms of India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Kathak.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shovana Narayan** is a recognised Indian **Kathak** dancer and a career officer with the Indian Audit and Accounts Service. 
 
• She performs in India and internationally, and has been awarded the **Padma Shri**. 
 
• She trained under **Birju Maharaj.**
 
• She has been awarded the** Padma Shri **and **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** for Dance.
 
• The world-famous Kathak dancer, **Pandit Birju Maharaj** is the face of the **Kalka-Bindadin Gharana** of Lucknow.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The number of classical dances ranges from eight to more, depending on the source and scholar.
 
• The Sangeet Natak Academy recognizes eight – 
 
 
• ​Bharatanatyam.
 
• Kathak.
 
• Kuchipudi.
 
• Odissi.
 
• Kathakali.
 
• Sattriya.
 
• Manipuri.
 
• Mohiniyattam.
